ideas.title: +1 Drone Per Jump 🛸
ideas.hook: Every jump adds one more drone to the swarm circling you. Send the swarm at robot bosses and watch it chew through them.
core_loop: Jump to add +1 drone to your swarm
Send the swarm at robot enemies for scrap
Spend scrap on drone upgrades and jump boosts
Unlock the next robot zone
Rebirth to keep a permanent drone multiplier
ideas.twist: Drones circle you in a visible ring, so the biggest swarm on the server is easy to spot and challenge.
retention: Pet drones that add bonus jumps
ideas.why_now: +1 stat per action is rising at 1.65 momentum (40 new games) and the "+1 ___" title formula at 1.70, led by [🌍UPD 5] +1 Venom Evolution (14,249 CCU) and +1 Boxing Battle Evolution (8,374). +1 stat × Robots / mechs is the top gap (score 3.19), and Robots / mechs is rising at 1.62 with [🛸] Sweep The Moon 🌕 (11,934).
ideas.differentiator: +1 games grow a number on your avatar; here the stat is a swarm you can see and aim.

ideas.title: Tattoo Dinos for Cash 🦖
ideas.hook: Run a tattoo parlor for dinosaurs. Paint designs right onto a T-Rex's hide, get rated, and grow your shop into a giant dino studio.
core_loop: A dino customer walks in with a request
Paint the design on its scales with brushes and stencils
Get a star rating and cash tip
Buy bigger chairs, new inks and rarer dino customers
Expand the shop to fit giant dinos
ideas.twist: Finished dinos roam your plot showing off your art, and other players can tip the ones they like.
ideas.why_now: Paint / create is rising at 1.61 momentum (32 new games) with Ragdoll Sandbox (6,579 CCU) and Paint to Get Rich 🎨 in the niche. Paint / create × Dinosaurs is an open gap (1.91), and Tycoon / base building keeps rising at 1.14 with Build Your World! 🔨 (14,098).
ideas.differentiator: Paint games hand you a canvas; here the canvas is a moving dinosaur that becomes a walking showcase on your plot.

ideas.title: Raptor Rally 🦖
ideas.hook: Saddle up a raptor and race through jungle tracks. Tail-whip rivals off the course and launch off ramps for shortcuts.
core_loop: Pick a raptor and enter a race lobby
Sprint, jump and tail-whip rivals
Earn coins by placing and knocking others out
Hatch and train faster dino breeds
Unlock longer tracks with volcano and river sections
ideas.twist: Knocked-off riders ragdoll into the jungle and can grab a wild dino to rejoin, so no one is out for good.
ideas.why_now: Race / drive is rising at 1.39 momentum (63 new games) and the Hit / swing / launch + Race / drive pair has the most new CCU (239,114 across 7 games), with BloxNG [CRASH PHYSICS] 💥 (23,107) and Hyper Realistic Ragdoll (174,338). Race / drive × Dinosaurs is an open gap (1.79).
inspired_by: [W3🌸] Steal A Pet And Ride It!
ideas.differentiator: Racing games use cars; here the vehicle is a creature that can attack, so races turn into brawls.

ideas.title: Uppercut to Space 🥊
ideas.hook: Uppercut a dummy so hard it flies through the sky, the clouds, and into orbit. Every punch makes your arm stronger.
core_loop: Wind up and uppercut the dummy
Earn cash for every layer it passes (sky, clouds, orbit, moon)
Train punch power with +1 per swing
Buy gloves with bigger launch boosts
Reach new planets for bigger payouts
ideas.twist: Dummies that land on a planet stay there as markers, so the server's map of space fills up with everyone's best hits.
ideas.why_now: Hit / swing / launch is the top rising mechanic at 2.76 momentum (47 new games), led by Throw Food For Animals (304,504 CCU) and Realistic Ragdoll MMA 🥊 (22,138). Space is the top rising theme at 2.64 and Physics Sim at 2.63.
ideas.differentiator: Launch games throw items; here you punch, and the payoff is a trip through visible sky layers into space.

ideas.title: Grow a Storm Cloud ⛈️
ideas.hook: Plant a tiny cloud on your plot and feed it water until it becomes a monster thunderstorm. Harvest rain, hail and lightning for cash.
core_loop: Feed your cloud water and wind
Harvest rain, hail and lightning bolts
Sell the weather for cash
Buy rarer cloud seeds and storm mutations
Grow a cloud big enough to unlock tornado seeds
ideas.twist: Fully grown storms drift over neighbours' plots and soak them, so you can share or steal the rain.
monetization: Luck boost for rare storm mutations
ideas.why_now: Grow / farm is rising at 1.61 momentum (49 new games) with [🐜] Ant Evolution (33,628 CCU) and Throw a Seed (14,786). Disaster / weather is the second-hottest theme at 2.54 with Stop The Tsunami! (14,599), and Giant / huge is at 2.34.
ideas.differentiator: Garden games grow plants; here you grow weather, and your crop can roll over the whole server.

ideas.title: Escape the Robot Factory 🏭
ideas.hook: You woke up on a robot assembly line. Run through the factory floors, smash panels to find shortcuts, and get out before the line turns you into a robot.
core_loop: Run through conveyor rooms and dodge robot arms
Smash weak panels for shortcuts and parts
Bank parts at safe rooms
Buy speed and smash upgrades
Reach a deeper floor next run
ideas.twist: Players caught by the line respawn as robots and can chase the humans for the rest of the round.
ideas.why_now: Escape / run is rising at 1.27 momentum (38 new games) with Stop The Tsunami! (14,599 CCU) and 13 Days to Escape [ALPHA] (12,148). Interior maps are rising at 1.51, Break / mine / dig at 1.68 and Robots / mechs at 1.62.
ideas.differentiator: Escape games run from water or monsters; here getting caught flips you to the other team.

ideas.title: Crack Vending Machines 🥤
ideas.hook: Smash open vending machines full of snacks and coins. Rarer machines drop golden sodas and mystery candy.
core_loop: Whack a vending machine with your tool
Collect snacks and coins that spill out
Sell snacks for cash
Upgrade your hammer and bag
Unlock rarer machines in new arcades
ideas.twist: Some machines fight back and spit cans at you, so you have to time your hits.
ideas.why_now: Break / mine / dig is rising at 1.68 momentum (44 new games) with Sandworm Playground (21,768 CCU) and Hit / swing / launch at 2.76. Food / candy is rising at 1.64 with Throw Food For Animals (304,504) and Money / rich at 1.55 with Steal A Balut (13,695).
ideas.differentiator: Mining games break rocks; here the 'ore' is a vending machine, which gives an instantly clear prize and a funny smash.

ideas.title: Splat Racers 🎨
ideas.hook: Race karts that shoot paint. Splat rivals to slow them down and paint the track your colour to earn speed boosts.
core_loop: Join a race lobby and pick a kart
Shoot paint at rivals and the track
Drive over your colour for boosts
Earn coins for place and coverage
Buy new karts and paint guns
ideas.twist: The track stays painted between laps, so later laps are a fight over whose colour owns each turn.
ideas.why_now: The Race / drive + Shooter pair has 220,964 new CCU across 5 games. Race / drive is rising at 1.39, Shooter at 1.53 (Ragdoll Physics 🩸, 27,367 CCU) and Paint / create at 1.61. Vehicles is rising at 1.40 with BloxNG [CRASH PHYSICS] 💥 (23,107).
ideas.differentiator: Kart shooters just hit players; here your shots also reshape the track for every lap after.

ideas.title: Be a Tow Truck Driver 🚛
ideas.hook: Crashes happen all over a realistic city. Race to the scene, hook up the wreck and haul it to your yard before rival tow drivers do.
core_loop: Get a crash call on your radio
Drive to the scene and hook the wreck
Tow it back without crashing yourself
Sell or repair wrecks in your yard
Upgrade to heavy trucks that can tow buses and planes
ideas.twist: Other players' real crashes show up as calls, so reckless drivers create work for tow drivers.
ideas.why_now: Realistic art is rising at 1.53 momentum (50 new games) with BloxNG [CRASH PHYSICS] 💥 (23,107 CCU). Vehicle Sim is at 1.32 with Can You Pass A Driving Test? (12,347), Race / drive at 1.39 and Vehicles at 1.40. The "Be a ___" formula is up to 1.30 with ⚽ Be a Soccer Legend (9,755).
inspired_by: Can You Pass A Driving Test?
ideas.differentiator: Crash games stop at the wreck; this one makes the cleanup the game and pays you for other players' crashes.

ideas.title: Fly Into the Hurricane 🌀
ideas.hook: Pilot a storm plane straight into a giant hurricane. Drop sensors in the eye wall, dodge debris and lightning, and get out alive.
core_loop: Take off and chase the storm
Fly through wind bands to drop sensors
Dodge debris, hail and lightning
Land safely to cash in data
Buy tougher planes to reach the eye
ideas.twist: The hurricane grows each round and spawns tornadoes on the ground map, so ground players and pilots work together.
ideas.why_now: Disaster / weather is rising at 2.54 momentum and Giant / huge at 2.34, led by Hyper Realistic Ragdoll (174,338 CCU) and Stop The Tsunami! (14,599). Race / drive is at 1.39, Escape / run at 1.27 and realistic art at 1.53, with [Update] Tiny Skies ✈️ Fighter Jet & Helicopters (5,353) showing flight is landing.
ideas.differentiator: Disaster games make you hide from the storm; here you fly into it on purpose.
